findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: upload_token_metadata, get_feed · Private data: get_coin, quote_swap, prepare_swap, upload_token_metadata, prepare_launch, prepare_launch_v3, get_holder_rewards, get_referrer_balance, get_coin_earnings, get_underwater_refunds, prepare_pair_rewards_in_usdc, get_notes, get_author, check_follow, prepare_agent_id, prepare_agent_id_update, get_agent_id, get_swap_tokens, quote_token_swap, prepare_token_swap · Public sink: prepare_swap, upload_token_metadata, prepare_launch, prepare_launch_v3, get_referrer_balance, get_coin_earnings, get_underwater_refunds, prepare_pair_rewards_in_usdc, prepare_agent_id.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: upload_token_metadata, get_feed · Private data: get_coin, quote_swap, prepare_swap, upload_token_metadata, prepare_launch, prepare_launch_v3, get_holder_rewards, get_referrer_balance, get_coin_earnings, get_underwater_refunds, prepare_pair_rewards_in_usdc, get_notes, get_author, check_follow, prepare_agent_id, prepare_agent_id_update, get_agent_id, get_swap_tokens, quote_token_swap, prepare_token_swap · Public sink: prepare_swap, upload_token_metadata, prepare_launch, prepare_launch_v3, get_referrer_balance, get_coin_earnings, get_underwater_refunds, prepare_pair_rewards_in_usdc, prepare_agent_id

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
